items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out with concussion after being evaluated for head injury mid-game vs Chiefs.
items.why: Concussion protocol; Schefter/Rapoport/ETR watching late injuries.
items.implication: Chargers WR targets shift to Quentin Johnston/others rest of game and potentially next week; monitor protocol timeline.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for LAC WR2/3 immediately and ROS if multi-week.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns. Only depth is Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (just signed off Vikings PS). Projections updated.
items.why: Ankle; pregame workout did not clear him; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed out.
items.implication: Browns RB committee limited to unproven McLaughlin/Estime; avoid CLE RBs or stream desperation only.
items.opportunity: Full backfield vacuum for McLaughlin/Estime carries/routes if used.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active. Still no early word on DJ Moore at time of post.
items.why: Groin; confirmed inactive by Schefter/Colts/Rapoport. Spears cleared knee.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers (Juwan Johnson etc per prior Berry notes); Spears returns to change-of-pace behind Pollard.
items.opportunity: TE targets to other Colts; Spears limited snaps/routes as usual 1B.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Core Sunday AM tracking of reports/practice.
items.implication: Primary status board for fantasy decisions; later updates flipped several GTD to OUT.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for outs as noted; Blue activation for PHI depth with Hurts/Barkley out.

items.text: Davante Adams (leg/knee) among Sunday injuries watching after non-contact issue late vs Cardinals; left game limping, did not return.
items.why: Non-contact knee while running route in red zone; finished 3/4 for 39 yards.
items.implication: Monitor Week 7 status vs Raiders; Puka Nacua already healthy so Adams WR2 floor lower if limited; potential snap/target loss.
items.opportunity: More work for Puka Nacua and other LAR WRs if Adams misses time.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
items.why: Confirmed inactive; Rapoport noted same from Bills list.
items.implication: BUF WR targets to other options (Palmer elevated); Moore owners need pivot.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Josh Palmer and remaining Bills WRs.

items.text: Cam Skattebo at RB28 (still start but riskier flex post-rotation), Najee Harris RB33. If starting NYG RB still prefers Cam for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but more flex than RB2; pre-season hate list reason. Prefer Najee over DK Metcalf for TD shot in some spots.
items.why: Rotation change news; still best chance at score due to explosiveness.
items.implication: Startable flex with risk; Happy Hour covered Judkins/Warren/Cam-Najee.
items.opportunity: Committee but Cam retains upside; Najee volume bump.
items.conflict: Usage downgrade vs still ranking as startable

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th/43 RBs in rush yards over expected + 4 fumbles (1 lost). Expectation of Giants RB rotation change: Najee Harris larger role, Skattebo downgraded but still mixed; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles per beat/sources; Harbaugh later said not benched by design but zero carries in one report.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex; Najee opportunity up in committee vs NO.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris snap/carry share expansion; Skattebo still explosive TD upside but lower volume.

items.text: Caleb Williams expected to play (full participant week); later confirmed back with Ben Johnson victory speeches.
items.implication: Bears offense back to normal; start Williams confidently.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 snaps/routes for CHI pass catchers (Odunze/Burden/Loveland).

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected to play (Brown activated/full practice; Henderson likely then active).
items.why: Brown excellent practice no limits; Henderson ankle cleared per Rapoport/Garafolo; both officially active.
items.implication: Brown full workload WR1 for NE; Henderson mixed but limited RZ/pass role behind Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Brown routes/targets high; Henderson some carries but Stevenson still lead.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring); out Monday vs WAS.
items.why: Hamstring DNP week; confirmed out in injury trackers for MNF.
items.implication: SF WR targets to Mike Evans/others; hold Deebo but pivot this week.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for remaining 49ers pass catchers (Evans elevated role).

items.text: Dalton Kincaid (ribs) returned to game; among late injuries watching but cleared to continue.
items.why: Ribs but returned; ETR watching list.
items.implication: BUF TE viable; no major loss of snaps.

items.text: With Huntley back expect run-heavy BAL vs CLE; all-in on Andy Reid at home off bye - Kenneth Walker fresh/ready. No hotter RB than Jaylen Warren.
items.implication: Strong start for both RBs in run-heavy environments.

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara expected to play.
items.why: Cleared expectations; Kamara returned from back earlier notes.
items.implication: Start both in favorable spots; NO offense normal.

sourceNotes.note: Sunday AM injury summary gold (GTD/Expected/Not/Activated); late injuries watch (Adams/McConkey/Kincaid); show schedule/projections hub. Core status tracking. Updated via Levitan on Judkins/Warren out, Spears active.
Player-specific: Judkins inactive + depth (McLaughlin/Estime only); Warren out/Spears active; Skattebo YOE 37th + 4 fumbles amid rotation; no early DJ Moore word; quoted ETR + updated projs.

Per-player: Skattebo still start but riskier flex RB28 post-rotation (prefer Najee over DK sometimes); Warren streamers context; loves run-heavy scripts for Walker/Jaylen Warren; Happy Hour covering Judkins/Warren/Cam-Najee.

Corroborated: Kamara/Olave expected then active; Henderson/AJB likely then active; Judkins pregame then out; DJ Moore out; McConkey out; broader QB/injury context including Hurts out indefinitely.
